summary: KAN-92 profile image upload is implemented on main (merged PR #48, commit 3e8b618). The provided diff origin/main...main is empty — local HEAD matches origin/main for application code — but HEAD satisfies all eight ACs: upload/update/remove in profile-form, JPG/JPEG/PNG/WEBP validation with 2MB cap and avatarError messages, immediate FileReader preview, localStorage persistence via UserService.persistUsers, and avatar display in Header, Sidebar, and Profile page. Success feedback appears on profile save; upload validation errors appear immediately. Minor gaps only: empty review diff, MIME-only type check, FileReader async test race, no sidebar avatar spec, tests not executed in this environment.

gaps: Provided git diff origin/main...main is empty; KAN-92 changes are already on main (PR #48 merge 3e8b618), not in the reviewed diff range.
AC Success and error messages are displayed for upload actions — success appears on profile save (profile.component.ts:64-68), not immediately on file selection; aligns with save-to-persist workflow.

AC Feature works correctly on desktop and mobile devices has responsive CSS (@media min-width 640px in profile-form; header .user-email display breakpoint) but no explicit viewport/mobile test coverage.

findings.title: Empty git diff on reviewed branch
findings.detail: origin/main...main produces zero file changes; KAN-92 implementation is already merged on main (PR #48). Review evaluates AC against HEAD codebase, not incremental diff hunks.

findings.title: No sidebar avatar rendering test
findings.detail: Header spec covers img.avatar-img when avatar is set; sidebar template binds profileUser()?.avatar but has no equivalent spec file.

findings.title: MIME-only file type validation
findings.detail: allowedTypes checks file.type only; a renamed non-image file with spoofed MIME could pass client validation.

findings.title: Valid-upload test ignores FileReader async
findings.detail: handles valid image upload asserts previewUrl() immediately after onFileSelected, but preview is set in reader.onload which is asynchronous.

checklist: All eight KAN-92 ACs addressed on main: upload, update/remove, format validation, error messages, immediate preview, localStorage persistence, Header/Sidebar/Profile display, responsive CSS.
Empty diff noted: feature pre-merged via PR #48; no new application changes on origin/main...main.
Run npm test in CI (Node >=22 per package.json engines) to confirm full suite passes.
Optional: add sidebar.component.spec.ts avatar image assertion mirroring header test.
